snippet.title: MANDATO TRAILER
snippet.description:
MANDATO is a short, story-driven first-person horror game inspired by Filipino culture and social issues. Explore a Filipino town where political influence reaches far beyond city hall—and uncover the disturbing reality hidden beneath promises, loyalty, and public image.

This release contains the first chapter of the story and takes approximately 35–45 minutes to complete.
